description: Live E2E for the Phantom Camera RQL module. Driven by scripts/extension_e2e.py (via scripts/extension_live.py) against ONE connected headless editor (with the pinned third-party Phantom Camera addon installed from extension.json testAddon and its PhantomCameraManager autoload registered) and a local gamedev-mcp-server. The module ships no MCP tools: every call is the core rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema, and a regression in the module (source, rows, mode calls, guide) turns the suite red.
notes: The 'setup' opens a fresh scene (root Node3D 'Root') with the core editor | call NewScene. rql-schema proves the module was discovered (its source). The 'tools' then run every PhantomCameraGuide example in order (the xUnit suite asserts this list contains them all, in order, each with rql-mutate for set / call and rql-query otherwise): the scene of the former phantomcamera-host-create (a Camera3D named 'Camera3D' under Root with a PhantomCameraHost under it), a 'Player' target and the 'PCam' camera; then read-backs and one rejected mode call. 'expect' substrings are matched against the default compact RQL text inside godot-cli's --raw JSON: rows are '|'-separated.

input.query: phantomcamera.cameras | where name == "PCam" | get node | set props["priority"] = 50, props["follow_damping"] = true
phantomcamera.cameras | select name scriptClass priority followMode followTarget lookAtMode lookAtTarget followDamping
godot.find("PCam") | select class props["priority"] props["follow_mode"] props["follow_target"]
